title: The Array Bound Is a Free NTTP
prompt: Implement `strLen` (N - 1, excluding the terminator) and `firstChar` (s[0]) deducing the size from the array reference — both `constexpr`, usable in `static_assert`.

tests.name: strLen excludes the terminator
tests.hint: return N - 1; — the bound counts the '\0'.

tests.name: firstChar reads through the same NTTP
tests.hint: return s[0]; — same deduction shape, different body.
